description: White wooden veranda-style building with decorative supports and railing, paved forecourt, asphalt road with white line, substantial red brick wall, ornate brick gateway with two prominent pillars and dark caps, unreadable light-colored sign above gateway, bare tree behind gateway, classic ornate street lamp with curved arm, dark-roofed buildings behind the brick wall.

Grey brick apartment building with curved balconies, patterned paved sidewalk, low green bushes, asphalt road with white pedestrian crossing markings, street light pole with blue circular sign, evergreen and deciduous trees, green hedges, black house with castellated parapet and multiple windows, house in background.

Ornate street lamppost, red-brown brick building facade, wavy dark lines on the upper brick wall, white-framed window, dark entrance door with decorative glass pattern (numbered 10), dark entrance door with decorative glass pattern (numbered 11), brick structure above the doors, white rectangular relief sculpture on the brick structure, arched upper-level entrance, number 13 on the left of the arched entrance, number 12 on the right of the arched entrance, brick steps leading upwards.
